description: This file contains a utility function 'update_lead_phone_numbers' that updates the phone and mobile number fields of a Lead document based on associated Contact's phone numbers within the ERPNext CRM module.

methods.name: update_lead_phone_numbers(contact, method)
methods.description: Updates the 'phone' and 'mobile_no' fields of a Lead document linked to a given Contact by selecting primary phone/mobile numbers or defaulting to the first available number.
